g.text: CSB and SDO use the module's own pull-ups: CSB high selects I2C;

g.desc: CSB and SDO use the module's own pull-ups: CSB high selects I2C;

g.text: SDO picks address 0x76 or 0x77, and the firmware tries both.

g.desc: SDO picks address 0x76 or 0x77, and the firmware tries both.

g.text: Intake panel, ESP32-C3. Net names on U1 GPIOs are the firmware pin constants without PIN_.

g.desc: Intake panel, ESP32-C3. Net names on U1 GPIOs are the firmware pin constants without PIN_.

g.text: U2 OUT+ / OUT- are the module's screw terminal (J6): speaker LS1 red to +, black to -, nothing else.

g.desc: U2 OUT+ / OUT- are the module's screw terminal (J6): speaker LS1 red to +, black to -, nothing else.

g.text: Off the board, on harnesses: U3 (J1), U4 or U5 + U6 (J2), SW1 (J3), SW2 (J4), BZ1 (J5), LS1 (J6), U7 (J7).

g.desc: Off the board, on harnesses: U3 (J1), U4 or U5 + U6 (J2), SW1 (J3), SW2 (J4), BZ1 (J5), LS1 (J6), U7 (J7).

g.text: U7: PN532 reader (Elechouse NFC Module V3, I2C mode: switch 1 ON, switch 2 OFF), fitted but optional; IRQ and RSTO unconnected.

g.desc: U7: PN532 reader (Elechouse NFC Module V3, I2C mode: switch 1 ON, switch 2 OFF), fitted but optional; IRQ and RSTO unconnected.

g.text: I2C addresses: 0x3C U3, 0x76/0x77 U4 or U5, 0x38 U6, 0x24 U7.

g.desc: I2C addresses: 0x3C U3, 0x76/0x77 U4 or U5, 0x38 U6, 0x24 U7.

g.text: Room air: fit U4 (BMP280 on a GY-BME/P280 board: temperature and pressure) or U5 + U6 (one BMP280 + AHT20 combination board on one 4-pin header: U5 is drawn as the combination board and U6 lists the AHT20's own ratings; adds humidity), not both.

g.desc: Room air: fit U4 (BMP280 on a GY-BME/P280 board: temperature and pressure) or U5 + U6 (one BMP280 + AHT20 combination board on one 4-pin header: U5 is drawn as the combination board and U6 lists the AHT20's own ratings; adds humidity), not both.

g.text: DNP by default: RI1, RI2 (only if no I2C board has pull-ups), RSD1 (only if SD reads near 0 V),

g.desc: DNP by default: RI1, RI2 (only if no I2C board has pull-ups), RSD1 (only if SD reads near 0 V),

g.text: C1 (only if 5 V sags on speech peaks). U2 GAIN open = 9 dB. GPIO 2, 8, 9 are strapping pins: unused.

g.desc: C1 (only if 5 V sags on speech peaks). U2 GAIN open = 9 dB. GPIO 2, 8, 9 are strapping pins: unused.

g.text: Not drawn: BRD1 ElectroCookie full board; XU1, two 8-pin female headers socketing U1; F1, F2 speaker ferrules.

g.desc: Not drawn: BRD1 ElectroCookie full board; XU1, two 8-pin female headers socketing U1; F1, F2 speaker ferrules.

g.text: SW1, SW2: the 5 V LED built into each button has its own series resistor; LAMP in net names means that LED.

g.desc: SW1, SW2: the 5 V LED built into each button has its own series resistor; LAMP in net names means that LED.

g.text: Q1, Q2: a 2N7000 may replace a BS170; its TO-92 pins are mirrored (S G D against D G S), so fit it turned round.

g.desc: Q1, Q2: a 2N7000 may replace a BS170; its TO-92 pins are mirrored (S G D against D G S), so fit it turned round.
